### 8. Screen States

| State | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Default | Show available actions. |
| Loading | Skeleton within affected section. |
| Loaded | Show source data. |
| Empty | Show an explanatory empty state. |
| Validation Error | Display field-specific correction. |
| Business Error | Show source-defined restriction. |
| Success | Show server-confirmed outcome. |
| Editing | Editable source-supported controls show the current draft/filter values; confirmed business data remains unchanged until an accepted write. |
| Read-only | Source records/history/results are read-only outside explicitly listed editable controls and lifecycle conditions; changing a filter does not change a business record. |
| Partial Data | Independent permitted areas may finish separately; show real loaded data plus per-area unavailable/retry. Never expose protected data or enable a dependent action before all its required checks succeed. |
| Disabled | Only controls whose documented Enabled When condition is false, whose request is pending or whose required business contract is unapproved are disabled; explain the actual reason. |

Các trạng thái không liệt kê không áp dụng cho luồng hiện được đặc tả; không tạo UI hoặc trạng thái business mới chỉ để đủ danh sách.

### 9. Validation Rules

Không có validation nhập business riêng; kiểm điều kiện action/role như mục 7 và 11.

### 10. Error Handling

Condition: Iframe embedding blocked

User-facing behavior: Show guidance and external YouTube option; no progress if video cannot be viewed

Retry: After playback issue is fixed

Navigation: External YouTube resource, not another CNHSK screen

Data preserved: Video/transcript context

Condition: Dictation empty/too long/short subtitle

User-facing behavior: 422 field/sentence error; no attempt/usage

Retry: Correct answer/choose sentence

Navigation: None

Data preserved: Answer draft

Condition: Pinyin conversion fails

User-facing behavior: Keep char_score if available; tone_score unavailable with warning

Retry: After conversion service recovers

Navigation: None

Data preserved: Valid character feedback

Condition: Microphone denied/unsupported

User-facing behavior: No API call/charge; permission guidance or hide unavailable recording control with explanation

Retry: After permission/support changes

Navigation: None

Data preserved: Other video activities

Condition: Audio too short/long or format unsupported

User-facing behavior: 422/415; no charge

Retry: Re-record valid audio

Navigation: None

Data preserved: Model sentence

Condition: Shadowing unverified/insufficient entitlement

User-facing behavior: 403 ACCOUNT_UNVERIFIED or402 INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS before assessment

Retry: After account/usage condition resolved

Navigation: SCR-004 or SCR-030

Data preserved: Sentence/local draft where feasible

Condition: Provider fails or invalid score/syllable count

User-facing behavior: 502 service error or500 SCORE_OUT_OF_RANGE; refund consumed source; no false result

Retry: New safe retry after service recovers

Navigation: None

Data preserved: Transcript and existing valid history

Áp dụng các quy tắc lỗi dùng chung phía trên khi request tương ứng có thể phát sinh; không đổi lỗi credentials thành refresh loop, không lộ private-resource existence hoặc stack trace.

### 11. Role / Permission Behavior

| Actor | Can View | Can Edit | Can Create | Can Archive/Delete | Can Approve/Reject | Special Restrictions |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| USER | Published player and own progress/attempts | Own raw Dictation answer and local recording | Own assessment and note/card | No public content/result deletion contract | No | Shadowing verified email; own results only; BUS-01 for private missing/foreign attempts. |

Role còn lại không có quyền thao tác được cấp riêng tại màn này; quyền public read không kéo theo quyền tạo/sửa. Không có role inheritance. SYSTEM không có menu hoặc phiên người dùng. Server kiểm lại role và ownership cho từng request.

### 12. Business Data & Status Values

Activity modes are UI modes, not new API enums. Video source PUBLISHED/UNAVAILABLE; stored attempts are historical results.

Dictionary popup can be in-place even if linked to SCR-025 semantics. Subtitle save source VIDEO, source_ref and snapshot example; invalid example may be omitted while valid word still saves. Existing recording is not replayable from saved Shadowing results because audio is discarded.

### 13. Confirmation / Modal Requirements

Dictionary word popup pauses playback and closes back to the active sentence; save-to-owned-deck dialog checks ownership/capacity/duplicate. Local recording preview/re-record stays inline and consumes nothing. Assessed submission shows approved entitlement before sending; assessment confirmation is a UX Recommendation. No separate popup/history/result screen.

Dialog/sheet là action bên trong màn, không phát sinh screen ID; giữ focus và trả về đúng trigger khi hủy.

### 14. Empty / No-Data State

Subtitle sentence: Không có phụ đề; unavailable study activity Own Dictation/Shadowing attempt: Chưa có lượt luyện câu này Filtered empty states offer clearing available filters; failed reads remain errors. Do not fabricate rows or substitute missing values with0. No subtitles: show “Không có phụ đề hợp lệ”, disable sentence practice and explain source unavailable. No own activity history: “Bạn chưa luyện câu này”. Missing assessment/word meaning is partial data, not0 or an invented score.

### 15. Loading / Partial Data

Initial load: preserve screen title/navigation, show skeleton only in the loading areas. Independent areas (Video and subtitle player, Learning controls, Dictation, Shadowing, Own attempt history) may show real loaded data while another area shows retry/unavailable. Disable only the submitting action. Keep valid draft/input and announced request state; do not show success,0, fabricated content or stale entitlement as a confirmed result.

### 16. Mockup Must Show

- Interactive timestamped subtitles
- Repeat>=3sec restriction
- Separate Dictation char/tone scores
- Separate Shadowing three measures and syllables
- Tone-assessment limitation notice
- Explicit Submit assessment versus free local recording
- No stored audio explanation

### 17. Mockup Must NOT Show

- Score from client
- Direct client-provider assessment
- Stored voice playback in result history
- Passive-view mastery
- Charge for playing, local recording or reading results
- Invent syllable tone-analysis beyond provider capability

### 18. UX Recommendations

Không áp dụng.

### 19. Responsive Behavior

Desktop: Keep primary data and related detail visible together.

Tablet: Stack secondary panels.

Mobile: Single column; usable primary actions.

### 20. Accessibility

Labels, keyboard operation and screen-specific status announcements.

Áp dụng accessibility chung; label không phụ thuộc placeholder, trạng thái không phụ thuộc màu, control có keyboard/focus và vùng thông báo phù hợp.

### 21. Dependencies / Related Screens

Related Screens:

- SCR-004
- SCR-025
- SCR-027
- SCR-029
- SCR-030
- SCR-037

Related Feature: Video Learning

Related Data: videos/user_progress(VIDEO); dictation_attempts and shadowing_attempts design; audio discarded; provider required.

### 22. Open Issues

- Assessment provider, supported formats, exact Shadowing allowance and any later tone/pitch assessment are unapproved.
- Legacy UC-031 gap says lookup quota unresolved; BR-031-5 says preloaded metadata is free and paid calls need policy. Do not charge existing internal lookup.
- Result correction/pinyin-specific displays require source output rather than fabricated scoring.

READY WITH PLACEHOLDERS

| --- | --- |

| Loading | Post list skeleton. |
| Loaded | Show returned rows and pagination. |
| Empty | Show category-specific empty state; avoid displaying private pending posts. |
| Read-only | GUEST can read public posts. |
| Business Error | Explain verification or account restriction for actions. |
| Unavailable | List failure is distinct from an empty feed. |
| Editing | Editable source-supported controls show the current draft/filter values; confirmed business data remains unchanged until an accepted write. |
| Validation Error | Associated field errors explain the rules listed in section9; preserve safe input, focus the first actionable error and do not commit invalid data. |
| Partial Data | Independent permitted areas may finish separately; show real loaded data plus per-area unavailable/retry. Never expose protected data or enable a dependent action before all its required checks succeed. |
| Disabled | Only controls whose documented Enabled When condition is false, whose request is pending or whose required business contract is unapproved are disabled; explain the actual reason. |

Các trạng thái không liệt kê không áp dụng cho luồng hiện được đặc tả; không tạo UI hoặc trạng thái business mới chỉ để đủ danh sách.

### 9. Validation Rules

Không có validation nhập business riêng; kiểm điều kiện action/role như mục 7 và 11.

### 10. Error Handling

Áp dụng các quy tắc lỗi dùng chung phía trên khi request tương ứng có thể phát sinh; không đổi lỗi credentials thành refresh loop, không lộ private-resource existence hoặc stack trace.

### 11. Role / Permission Behavior

| Actor | Can View | Can Edit | Can Create | Can Archive/Delete | Can Approve/Reject | Special Restrictions |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GUEST | APPROVED public posts | No | No | No | No | Sign in for community actions and profile navigation. |
| USER | Public approved posts and own nonpublic posts | Own eligible posts via SCR-041 | Verified email required | Own post soft deletion where defined | No | No implicit staff-role inheritance; hidden or foreign nonpublic posts are inaccessible. |

Role còn lại không có quyền thao tác được cấp riêng tại màn này; quyền public read không kéo theo quyền tạo/sửa. Không có role inheritance. SYSTEM không có menu hoặc phiên người dùng. Server kiểm lại role và ownership cho từng request.

### 12. Business Data & Status Values

Stored post states DRAFT, PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED, HIDDEN. Public feed shows APPROVED only.

Author identity comes from the authenticated session. Public cards contain display name/avatar only, not email or account details.

### 13. Confirmation / Modal Requirements

Dialogs remain inside this screen.

Dialog/sheet là action bên trong màn, không phát sinh screen ID; giữ focus và trả về đúng trigger khi hủy.

### 14. Empty / No-Data State

Community post: No approved posts in this category; or no own posts, with create action. Filtered empty states offer clearing available filters; failed reads remain errors. Do not fabricate rows or substitute missing values with0.

### 15. Loading / Partial Data

Initial load: preserve screen title/navigation, show skeleton only in the loading areas. Independent areas (Post feed, Category and list mode, Create action) may show real loaded data while another area shows retry/unavailable. Disable only the submitting action. Keep valid draft/input and announced request state; do not show success,0, fabricated content or stale entitlement as a confirmed result.

### 16. Mockup Must Show

- Category
- Actual counts
- Public versus my-post context
- Latest moderation reason only for its owner

### 17. Mockup Must NOT Show

- Pending/rejected/hidden posts in public feed
- Create quiz action
- Email or reporter identities
- Unapproved automatic report-hide threshold

### 18. UX Recommendations

Không áp dụng.

### 19. Responsive Behavior

Desktop: Keep primary data and related detail visible together.

Tablet: Stack secondary panels.

Mobile: Single column; usable primary actions.

### 20. Accessibility

Labels, keyboard operation and screen-specific status announcements.

Áp dụng accessibility chung; label không phụ thuộc placeholder, trạng thái không phụ thuộc màu, control có keyboard/focus và vùng thông báo phù hợp.

### 21. Dependencies / Related Screens

Related Screens:

- SCR-040
- SCR-041
- SCR-042
- SCR-002

Related Feature: Community

Related Data: community.posts with public user information through the auth module API.

- UC-070 does not define keyword search, page size or exact preview length; reserve UI space without invented business bounds.
- UC-134 and older UCs disagree on some 400/422 and unverified-account response codes; final API contract must normalize them.

READY WITH PLACEHOLDERS

### 8. Screen States

| State | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Default | Show available actions. |
| Loading | Skeleton within affected section. |
| Loaded | Show source data. |
| Empty | Show an explanatory empty state. |
| Validation Error | Display field-specific correction. |
| Business Error | Show source-defined restriction. |
| Success | Show server-confirmed outcome. |
| Editing | Editable source-supported controls show the current draft/filter values; confirmed business data remains unchanged until an accepted write. |
| Read-only | Source records/history/results are read-only outside explicitly listed editable controls and lifecycle conditions; changing a filter does not change a business record. |
| Partial Data | Independent permitted areas may finish separately; show real loaded data plus per-area unavailable/retry. Never expose protected data or enable a dependent action before all its required checks succeed. |
| Disabled | Only controls whose documented Enabled When condition is false, whose request is pending or whose required business contract is unapproved are disabled; explain the actual reason. |

Các trạng thái không liệt kê không áp dụng cho luồng hiện được đặc tả; không tạo UI hoặc trạng thái business mới chỉ để đủ danh sách.

### 9. Validation Rules

Field / Action: comment_content

Condition: Blank or >5,000 characters

Message: Nhập bình luận từ 1 đến 5.000 ký tự.

UI Response: Do not submit; preserve typed comment.

Data State: No comment created.

Field / Action: report_reason

Condition: No approved reason selected

Message: Chọn lý do báo cáo.

UI Response: Keep report modal open.

Data State: No report created.

### 10. Error Handling

Condition: POST_NOT_APPROVED or COMMENTS_LOCKED

User-facing behavior: Show read-only restriction; disable comment/like as applicable.

Retry: Reload after state changes.

Navigation: SCR-039

Data preserved: Typed comment where safe.

Condition: ACCOUNT_UNVERIFIED

User-facing behavior: Explain verified email requirement.

Retry: After verification.

Navigation: SCR-004

Data preserved: Typed content.

Condition: DUPLICATE_REPORT / SELF_REPORT / REPORT_ABUSE

User-facing behavior: Show specific restriction without exposing reporter identity.

Retry: Only when allowed.

Navigation: Remain SCR-040

Data preserved: Report details.

Condition: Foreign/nonpublic private target

User-facing behavior: 403 according to BUS-01; do not leak its existence.

Retry: No

Navigation: SCR-039

Data preserved: No private data.

Áp dụng các quy tắc lỗi dùng chung phía trên khi request tương ứng có thể phát sinh; không đổi lỗi credentials thành refresh loop, không lộ private-resource existence hoặc stack trace.

### 11. Role / Permission Behavior

| Actor | Can View | Can Edit | Can Create | Can Archive/Delete | Can Approve/Reject | Special Restrictions |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GUEST | Approved public post and visible comments | No | No | No | No | Reading only. |
| USER | Approved public post; own permitted nonpublic post | Own post and own comment within policy | Verified email for comment/reply | Own content soft deletion | No | No commenting on nonapproved or locked post; no self-report; profile requires USER. |

Role còn lại không có quyền thao tác được cấp riêng tại màn này; quyền public read không kéo theo quyền tạo/sửa. Không có role inheritance. SYSTEM không có menu hoặc phiên người dùng. Server kiểm lại role và ownership cho từng request.

### 12. Business Data & Status Values

Post DRAFT/PENDING/APPROVED/REJECTED/HIDDEN; comment VISIBLE/HIDDEN/DELETED; report status is manager-only PENDING/ACTIONED/REJECTED.

Replies stay in the same post and cannot change parent. Like is idempotent. Reports remain private and do not automatically hide content until a threshold is approved.

### 13. Confirmation / Modal Requirements

Report modal with target read-only, reason selector pending catalogue and optional detail; own delete confirmation.

Dialog/sheet là action bên trong màn, không phát sinh screen ID; giữ focus và trả về đúng trigger khi hủy.

### 14. Empty / No-Data State

Comment/reply: Chưa có bình luận. USER can start a discussion. Filtered empty states offer clearing available filters; failed reads remain errors. Do not fabricate rows or substitute missing values with0. No visible comments: “Chưa có bình luận”; offer comment only to eligible USER or sign-in to GUEST. Deleted/hidden parent comments use source placeholder while descendants remain. Inaccessible post is not an empty successful detail.

### 15. Loading / Partial Data

Initial load: preserve screen title/navigation, show skeleton only in the loading areas. Independent areas (Post, Comments, USER actions) may show real loaded data while another area shows retry/unavailable. Disable only the submitting action. Keep valid draft/input and announced request state; do not show success,0, fabricated content or stale entitlement as a confirmed result.

### 16. Mockup Must Show

- Actual like/comment counts
- Deleted-parent placeholder
- Locked/read-only explanation
- Verification requirement
- Own edit returns post to review

### 17. Mockup Must NOT Show

- Reporter identity
- Automatic hide after five reports
- Fourth nesting level
- Comment preapproval workflow
- Foreign private content

### 18. UX Recommendations

Không áp dụng.

### 19. Responsive Behavior

Desktop: Keep primary data and related detail visible together.

Tablet: Stack secondary panels.

Mobile: Single column; usable primary actions.

### 20. Accessibility

Labels, keyboard operation and screen-specific status announcements.

Áp dụng accessibility chung; label không phụ thuộc placeholder, trạng thái không phụ thuộc màu, control có keyboard/focus và vùng thông báo phù hợp.

### 8. Screen States

| State | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Default | Empty editor for create. |
| Loading | Load own editable post. |
| Loaded | Populate title/category/content and own review state. |
| Editing | Track unsaved changes. |
| Validation Error | Inline title/category/content correction. |
| Business Error | Verification, rate or account restriction. |
| Read-only | Noneditable/foreign content does not expose an editor. |
| Success | Confirm draft saved or submitted for review. |
| Partial Data | Independent permitted areas may finish separately; show real loaded data plus per-area unavailable/retry. Never expose protected data or enable a dependent action before all its required checks succeed. |
| Disabled | Only controls whose documented Enabled When condition is false, whose request is pending or whose required business contract is unapproved are disabled; explain the actual reason. |

Các trạng thái không liệt kê không áp dụng cho luồng hiện được đặc tả; không tạo UI hoặc trạng thái business mới chỉ để đủ danh sách.

### 9. Validation Rules

Field / Action: content

Condition: Blank or >50,000 characters

Message: Nhập nội dung không vượt quá 50.000 ký tự.

UI Response: Keep editor and focus content.

Data State: No write.

Field / Action: title

Condition: Blank or exceeds final contract maximum

Message: Tiêu đề không hợp lệ.

UI Response: Preserve content; use approved bound when available.

Data State: No write.

### 10. Error Handling

Condition: ACCOUNT_UNVERIFIED

User-facing behavior: Explain verification and preserve draft locally within session.

Retry: After verified email.

Navigation: SCR-004

Data preserved: Title, category, content.

Condition: Daily post limit/account restricted

User-facing behavior: Show source restriction and time/reason when provided.

Retry: When restriction ends.

Navigation: Remain SCR-041

Data preserved: All writable input.

Condition: Ownership failure

User-facing behavior: 403 BUS-01; no foreign editor data.

Retry: No

Navigation: SCR-039

Data preserved: No foreign content.

Áp dụng các quy tắc lỗi dùng chung phía trên khi request tương ứng có thể phát sinh; không đổi lỗi credentials thành refresh loop, không lộ private-resource existence hoặc stack trace.

### 11. Role / Permission Behavior

| Actor | Can View | Can Edit | Can Create | Can Archive/Delete | Can Approve/Reject | Special Restrictions |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| USER | Own editor and moderation reason | Own posts only | Verified email and unrestricted account | Via own detail action | No | Cannot set author, approved status, moderator or review reason. |

Role còn lại không có quyền thao tác được cấp riêng tại màn này; quyền public read không kéo theo quyền tạo/sửa. Không có role inheritance. SYSTEM không có menu hoặc phiên người dùng. Server kiểm lại role và ownership cho từng request.

### 12. Business Data & Status Values

New/save draft DRAFT; submit/revise PENDING; moderator outcomes APPROVED/REJECTED; HIDDEN is not client-selectable.

BR069-6 and its test allow approved edits returning to PENDING; earlier A3 prohibition is stale. Latest rejection reason only. Title/content/category are the only writable post fields.

### 13. Confirmation / Modal Requirements

Dialogs remain inside this screen.

Dialog/sheet là action bên trong màn, không phát sinh screen ID; giữ focus và trả về đúng trigger khi hủy.

### 14. Empty / No-Data State

Create mode: blank title/content and an unchosen supported category. No existing rejection reason: omit reason panel. Empty required fields get associated errors on submit; do not auto-fill invented post content.

### 15. Loading / Partial Data

Initial load: preserve screen title/navigation, show skeleton only in the loading areas. Independent areas (Editor, Review status, Save/submit) may show real loaded data while another area shows retry/unavailable. Disable only the submitting action. Keep valid draft/input and announced request state; do not show success,0, fabricated content or stale entitlement as a confirmed result.

### 16. Mockup Must Show

- Category selection
- Review consequence
- Latest own rejection reason
- Unsaved-change handling

### 17. Mockup Must NOT Show

- Client-selectable APPROVED status
- Author selector
- Moderator fields
- Legacy prohibition on every approved-post edit

### 18. UX Recommendations

Không áp dụng.

### 19. Responsive Behavior

Desktop: Keep primary data and related detail visible together.

Tablet: Stack secondary panels.

Mobile: Single column; usable primary actions.

### 20. Accessibility

Labels, keyboard operation and screen-specific status announcements.

Áp dụng accessibility chung; label không phụ thuộc placeholder, trạng thái không phụ thuộc màu, control có keyboard/focus và vùng thông báo phù hợp.

### 21. Dependencies / Related Screens

Related Screens:

- SCR-039
- SCR-040
- SCR-004

Related Feature: Community

Related Data: Source-owned resources.

### 22. Open Issues

- Title maximum conflicts: legacy UI 200 characters versus database 300; no approved business bound resolves it.
- Five posts/day appears as proposal/exception-test policy; do not silently ratify it.
- 400 versus 422 validation and unverified-account responses conflict across UC-069/UC-134.

### 23. Mockup Readiness

READY WITH PLACEHOLDERS

Reason: Editor structure is ready; title bound, provisional cap and API error contract need confirmation.

| Actor | Can View | Can Edit | Can Create | Can Archive/Delete | Can Approve/Reject | Special Restrictions |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| USER | Available quiz sets and own attempt context | No question-bank editing | Owned attempt | No question-bank deletion | No | Only approved questions are usable; no quiz creation UI for learner. |

Role còn lại không có quyền thao tác được cấp riêng tại màn này; quyền public read không kéo theo quyền tạo/sửa. Không có role inheritance. SYSTEM không có menu hoặc phiên người dùng. Server kiểm lại role và ownership cho từng request.

### 12. Business Data & Status Values

Attempt can be in progress or submitted as source behavior; do not invent quiz publication enums beyond approved question availability.

First completed attempt alone contributes to ranking; abandoned attempts do not. Repeating is allowed. Quiz never changes knowledge mastery.

### 13. Confirmation / Modal Requirements

Dialogs remain inside this screen.

Dialog/sheet là action bên trong màn, không phát sinh screen ID; giữ focus và trả về đúng trigger khi hủy.

### 14. Empty / No-Data State

Quiz set: Chưa có bộ câu hỏi được duyệt cho chủ đề này. Filtered empty states offer clearing available filters; failed reads remain errors. Do not fabricate rows or substitute missing values with0.

### 15. Loading / Partial Data

Initial load: preserve screen title/navigation, show skeleton only in the loading areas. Independent areas (Quiz topic list, Attempt context) may show real loaded data while another area shows retry/unavailable. Disable only the submitting action. Keep valid draft/input and announced request state; do not show success,0, fabricated content or stale entitlement as a confirmed result.

- Topic
- Question count
- Approved-question availability
- First-attempt ranking rule
- No mastery effect

### 17. Mockup Must NOT Show

- User quiz creation
- Unapproved questions
- Answer keys
- Invented timer or passing threshold

Không áp dụng.

- Older legacy fields describe learner-created quizzes; UC-080 uses approved question banks, so no create-quiz learner action is retained.

READY WITH PLACEHOLDERS

Reason: Quiz list behavior is defined; topic metadata and pagination await contract.

### 10. Error Handling

Condition: ATTEMPT_SUBMITTED

User-facing behavior: Do not submit twice; open owned result if available.

Retry: No duplicate submit.

Navigation: SCR-045

Data preserved: Existing server result.

Condition: IMPOSSIBLE_DURATION

User-facing behavior: Explain invalid attempt; no ranking contribution.

Retry: New attempt if allowed.

Navigation: SCR-043

Data preserved: No fabricated score.

Condition: Network submission failure

User-facing behavior: Keep raw answers and determine server submission state before retry.

Retry: Retry safely after state check.

Navigation: Remain SCR-044

Data preserved: Raw answers.

Condition: Foreign/missing private attempt

User-facing behavior: 403 BUS-01.

Retry: No

Navigation: SCR-043

Data preserved: No private data.

### 12. Business Data & Status Values

Use active/submitted/abandoned as descriptive UI behavior unless contract defines stored status. Do not add an API enum.

No mastery update. All raw answers go to server grading. Time is measured for ranking/tie-break and plausibility, not a newly invented deadline.

### 13. Confirmation / Modal Requirements

Final submission and abandon confirmations within this screen.

Dialog/sheet là action bên trong màn, không phát sinh screen ID; giữ focus và trả về đúng trigger khi hủy.

No approved questions: show “Quiz chưa có câu hỏi được duyệt”; no active attempt or score is invented, return SCR-043. Unanswered questions remain visibly unanswered under the final answer contract.

Initial load: preserve screen title/navigation, show skeleton only in the loading areas. Keep valid draft/input and announced request state; do not show success,0, fabricated content or stale entitlement as a confirmed result.

### 8. Screen States

| State | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Loaded | Own submitted result and available ranking. |
| Loading | Result and ranking sections load independently. |
| Partial Data | Own score remains visible if ranking is unavailable; do not display false rank zero. |
| Business Error | Unsubmitted result cannot show graded detail. |
| Unavailable | Own result failure distinct from absent ranking. |
| Read-only | All graded result fields are immutable. |
| Disabled | Only controls whose documented Enabled When condition is false, whose request is pending or whose required business contract is unapproved are disabled; explain the actual reason. |

Các trạng thái không liệt kê không áp dụng cho luồng hiện được đặc tả; không tạo UI hoặc trạng thái business mới chỉ để đủ danh sách.

### 9. Validation Rules

Không có validation nhập business riêng; kiểm điều kiện action/role như mục 7 và 11.

### 10. Error Handling

Condition: Attempt not submitted

User-facing behavior: No score or answer detail; explain completion required.

Retry: Complete own active attempt.

Navigation: SCR-044

Data preserved: Owned attempt context.

Condition: Ranking cache unavailable

User-facing behavior: Use database fallback; if still unavailable show explicit ranking failure while retaining own score.

Retry: Reload ranking.

Navigation: Remain SCR-045

Data preserved: Own result.

Condition: Foreign/missing private result

User-facing behavior: 403 BUS-01.

Retry: No

Navigation: SCR-043

Data preserved: No private data.

Áp dụng các quy tắc lỗi dùng chung phía trên khi request tương ứng có thể phát sinh; không đổi lỗi credentials thành refresh loop, không lộ private-resource existence hoặc stack trace.

### 11. Role / Permission Behavior

| Actor | Can View | Can Edit | Can Create | Can Archive/Delete | Can Approve/Reject | Special Restrictions |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| USER | Own submitted result plus public ranking names/scores/time | No | Retry via SCR-044 | No | No | Never expose other users' raw answers or private identities. |

Role còn lại không có quyền thao tác được cấp riêng tại màn này; quyền public read không kéo theo quyền tạo/sửa. Không có role inheritance. SYSTEM không có menu hoặc phiên người dùng. Server kiểm lại role và ownership cho từng request.

### 12. Business Data & Status Values

Submitted result; ranking eligibility is first completed attempt only, descriptive UI labels.

Repeat result can improve practice score but cannot replace first-attempt ranking. Correct/wrong summaries are defined; detailed explanations are optional only if provided by source contract.

### 13. Confirmation / Modal Requirements

Dialogs remain inside this screen.

Dialog/sheet là action bên trong màn, không phát sinh screen ID; giữ focus và trả về đúng trigger khi hủy.

### 14. Empty / No-Data State

Top ten ranked users: Chưa có kết quả xếp hạng. Filtered empty states offer clearing available filters; failed reads remain errors. Do not fabricate rows or substitute missing values with0. No submitted owned result is an unavailable/in-progress condition, not a zero score. No ranking contribution/position shows an explanation rather than rank0. First/repeat-attempt context is shown only from confirmed attempt data.

### 15. Loading / Partial Data

Initial load: preserve screen title/navigation, show skeleton only in the loading areas. Independent areas (Own result, Ranking context, Next practice) may show real loaded data while another area shows retry/unavailable. Disable only the submitting action. Keep valid draft/input and announced request state; do not show success,0, fabricated content or stale entitlement as a confirmed result.

### 16. Mockup Must Show

- Server score
- Correct and wrong totals
- Duration
- Current result versus first-attempt rank
- Ranking unavailable state

### 17. Mockup Must NOT Show

- Foreign answers
- Email or private identity
- False rank zero
- Mastery effect
- Invented pass/fail threshold

### 18. UX Recommendations

Không áp dụng.

### 19. Responsive Behavior

Desktop: Keep primary data and related detail visible together.

Tablet: Stack secondary panels.

Mobile: Single column; usable primary actions.

### 20. Accessibility

Labels, keyboard operation and screen-specific status announcements.

Áp dụng accessibility chung; label không phụ thuộc placeholder, trạng thái không phụ thuộc màu, control có keyboard/focus và vùng thông báo phù hợp.

### 21. Dependencies / Related Screens

Related Screens:

- SCR-043
- SCR-044
- SCR-046

Related Feature: Community Quiz

Related Data: Owned quiz attempt result; ranking source is database with Redis cache/fallback.

### 22. Open Issues

- Detailed answer review/explanation fields are not clearly specified by UC-081; show only if API contract supplies them.

### 23. Mockup Readiness

READY WITH PLACEHOLDERS

Reason: Result and ranking summaries are defined; optional answer review remains a placeholder.

### 8. Screen States

| State | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Default | Show available actions. |
| Loading | Skeleton within affected section. |
| Loaded | Show source data. |
| Empty | Show an explanatory empty state. |
| Validation Error | Display field-specific correction. |
| Business Error | Show source-defined restriction. |
| Success | Show server-confirmed outcome. |
| Editing | Editable source-supported controls show the current draft/filter values; confirmed business data remains unchanged until an accepted write. |
| Read-only | Source records/history/results are read-only outside explicitly listed editable controls and lifecycle conditions; changing a filter does not change a business record. |
| Partial Data | Independent permitted areas may finish separately; show real loaded data plus per-area unavailable/retry. Never expose protected data or enable a dependent action before all its required checks succeed. |
| Disabled | Only controls whose documented Enabled When condition is false, whose request is pending or whose required business contract is unapproved are disabled; explain the actual reason. |

Các trạng thái không liệt kê không áp dụng cho luồng hiện được đặc tả; không tạo UI hoặc trạng thái business mới chỉ để đủ danh sách.

### 9. Validation Rules

Không có validation nhập business riêng; kiểm điều kiện action/role như mục 7 và 11.

### 10. Error Handling

Condition: Invalid game/period or historical period

User-facing behavior: Show valid-selector guidance; reject invalid filter.

Retry: Choose supported value.

Navigation: Remain SCR-047

Data preserved: Last valid list.

Condition: Cache/data load error

User-facing behavior: Use database fallback; show unavailable if fallback fails.

Retry: Reload ranking.

Navigation: Remain SCR-047

Data preserved: Current filters.

Áp dụng các quy tắc lỗi dùng chung phía trên khi request tương ứng có thể phát sinh; không đổi lỗi credentials thành refresh loop, không lộ private-resource existence hoặc stack trace.

### 11. Role / Permission Behavior

| Actor | Can View | Can Edit | Can Create | Can Archive/Delete | Can Approve/Reject | Special Restrictions |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GUEST | Public top fifty per game | No | No | No | No | No own-rank or private game history. |
| USER | Public ranks and own rank when supplied | No | Own game session through SCR-035 | No | No | Scores must be server validated; game ranks are separate, never compare an invented total across games. |

Role còn lại không có quyền thao tác được cấp riêng tại màn này; quyền public read không kéo theo quyền tạo/sửa. Không có role inheritance. SYSTEM không có menu hoặc phiên người dùng. Server kiểm lại role và ownership cho từng request.

### 12. Business Data & Status Values

No new rank status enum; invalid/suspicious scores and restricted accounts are excluded according to source policy.

Public game leaderboard is V2 under UC-083 BR1 even though the feature tree uses a stale immediate-MVP-ranking phrase. Four core games are MVP; pinyin game is V2.

### 13. Confirmation / Modal Requirements

Dialogs remain inside this screen.

Dialog/sheet là action bên trong màn, không phát sinh screen ID; giữ focus và trả về đúng trigger khi hủy.

### 14. Empty / No-Data State

Top fifty game ranks: Chưa có kết quả xếp hạng cho trò chơi này. Filtered empty states offer clearing available filters; failed reads remain errors. Do not fabricate rows or substitute missing values with0.

### 15. Loading / Partial Data

Initial load: preserve screen title/navigation, show skeleton only in the loading areas. Independent areas (Game and period, Top fifty, Own rank) may show real loaded data while another area shows retry/unavailable. Disable only the submitting action. Keep valid draft/input and announced request state; do not show success,0, fabricated content or stale entitlement as a confirmed result.

### 16. Mockup Must Show

- Selected game
- Current period
- Score and duration
- Top fifty
- Owned highlight only for USER

### 17. Mockup Must NOT Show

- Historical period browser

- False zero rank
- Private player details

Không áp dụng.

Tablet: Stack secondary panels.

### 11. Role / Permission Behavior

| Actor | Can View | Can Edit | Can Create | Can Archive/Delete | Can Approve/Reject | Special Restrictions |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GUEST | Published contest information | No | No | No | No | Public contest information only; result link first authenticates through SCR-002 before SCR-051. |
| USER | Published information and own participation | Own registration only | Free own registration | Cancel before start if permitted | No | No role inheritance, no fee, capacity only if configured. |

Role còn lại không có quyền thao tác được cấp riêng tại màn này; quyền public read không kéo theo quyền tạo/sửa. Không có role inheritance. SYSTEM không có menu hoặc phiên người dùng. Server kiểm lại role và ownership cho từng request.

### 12. Business Data & Status Values

Stored DRAFT/PUBLISHED/CLOSED/CANCELLED; computed upcoming/ongoing/ended; registered state is own relationship, not an invented enum.

Joining once is free. Capacity cannot be assumed if absent. Physical prize fulfillment occurs outside the system; credit prizes require FINANCE_ADMIN issuance.

### 13. Confirmation / Modal Requirements

Own cancellation confirmation; registration feedback inline.

Dialog/sheet là action bên trong màn, không phát sinh screen ID; giữ focus và trả về đúng trigger khi hủy.

### 14. Empty / No-Data State

No optional prize description/capacity: omit the item or say source has not supplied it; never infer no prize or unlimited capacity. No own registration: show eligible registration/login action. No results yet: show publication guidance; authenticated boundary remains.

### 15. Loading / Partial Data

Initial load: preserve screen title/navigation, show skeleton only in the loading areas. Independent areas (Contest information, Participation status, Action by schedule) may show real loaded data while another area shows retry/unavailable. Disable only the submitting action. Keep valid draft/input and announced request state; do not show success,0, fabricated content or stale entitlement as a confirmed result.

### 16. Mockup Must Show

- Exact schedule/timezone
- Published rules
- Own registration state
- Schedule-specific eligibility explanation
- Publication condition for results

### 17. Mockup Must NOT Show

- Entry payment
- Invented capacity
- Unratified late-entry cutoff
- Automatic disqualification for tab switch
- Public private attempts

Không áp dụng.

- Verified email is recommended in BR4 but rejected in T6 when unverified; final participation/prize verification requirement is unresolved.
- UC-090 public result-link wording requires a sign-in boundary consistent with authenticated SCR-051 in the approved flow; publication payload is unresolved.

READY WITH PLACEHOLDERS

User-facing behavior: Block attempt, show source restriction.

Retry: Only when eligible.

Navigation: SCR-049

Data preserved: Selected contest; no foreign questions.

Condition: ALREADY_SUBMITTED

User-facing behavior: Do not resubmit; use existing result status.

Retry: No

Navigation: SCR-051

Data preserved: Server submission.

Condition: AFTER_DEADLINE

User-facing behavior: Explain rejected submission; do not invent grace approval.

Retry: No after final deadline.

Navigation: SCR-049 or SCR-051 when publication allows

Data preserved: Local raw answers where policy allows.

Condition: Network failure

User-facing behavior: Preserve raw answers; verify server submission state before retry; server time still governs.

Retry: Retry while allowed.

Navigation: Remain SCR-050

Data preserved: Raw answers.

### 12. Business Data & Status Values

Contest DRAFT/PUBLISHED/CLOSED/CANCELLED; attempt submitted state is source-defined behavior. No invented forfeited/disqualified state.

Tab changes are logged for audit and do not automatically disqualify. Grace up to five seconds is a proposal, not a final entitlement. No approved per-question timer exists.

### 13. Confirmation / Modal Requirements

Final submit and leave confirmations within the attempt screen.

Dialog/sheet là action bên trong màn, không phát sinh screen ID; giữ focus và trả về đúng trigger khi hủy.

### 14. Empty / No-Data State

No assigned questions or unavailable contest exam: explain unavailability and keep entry blocked; return SCR-049. Unanswered items keep blank/answered markers. No fabricated submitted attempt or score.

### 15. Loading / Partial Data

Initial load: preserve screen title/navigation, show skeleton only in the loading areas. Keep valid draft/input and announced request state; do not show success,0, fabricated content or stale entitlement as a confirmed result.

### 8. Screen States

| State | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Loading | Publication and own result/ranking load independently. |
| Loaded | Published allowed data. |
| Read-only | Results immutable. |
| Blocked | Before publication or when actor visibility is forbidden, show explanation without private result payload. |
| Partial Data | Own confirmed score remains visible when allowed even if ranking unavailable. |
| Empty | Published ranking with no qualifying entries only. |
| Unavailable | Read error distinct from unpublished and empty. |
| Disabled | Only controls whose documented Enabled When condition is false, whose request is pending or whose required business contract is unapproved are disabled; explain the actual reason. |

Các trạng thái không liệt kê không áp dụng cho luồng hiện được đặc tả; không tạo UI hoặc trạng thái business mới chỉ để đủ danh sách.

### 9. Validation Rules

Không có validation nhập business riêng; kiểm điều kiện action/role như mục 7 và 11.

### 10. Error Handling

Condition: Ranking before contest ends/publication

User-facing behavior: Show results not yet published; source may return 403 or publication response.

Retry: After publication.

Navigation: SCR-049

Data preserved: Public contest metadata.

Condition: Private/foreign result

User-facing behavior: 403 BUS-01, no raw answers or private identity.

Retry: No

Navigation: SCR-049

Data preserved: No private payload.

Condition: Ranking unavailable

User-facing behavior: Show failure rather than zero rank; retain allowed own result.

Retry: Reload.

Navigation: Remain SCR-051

Data preserved: Allowed own score.

Áp dụng các quy tắc lỗi dùng chung phía trên khi request tương ứng có thể phát sinh; không đổi lỗi credentials thành refresh loop, không lộ private-resource existence hoặc stack trace.

### 11. Role / Permission Behavior

| Actor | Can View | Can Edit | Can Create | Can Archive/Delete | Can Approve/Reject | Special Restrictions |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| USER | Own authorized result and published ranking under final policy | No | No | No | No | Authenticated flow is default; result publication and owner rules apply. |

Role còn lại không có quyền thao tác được cấp riêng tại màn này; quyền public read không kéo theo quyền tạo/sửa. Không có role inheritance. SYSTEM không có menu hoặc phiên người dùng. Server kiểm lại role và ownership cho từng request.

### 12. Business Data & Status Values

Contest CLOSED or ended schedule does not alone make results available. Availability requires the source-defined publication check; this screen remains authenticated USER. No new publication enum or prize-paid state.

Approved flow requires explicit authenticated USER. Publication controls which server-confirmed result/ranking projection is available; own detail remains private. Public information link authenticates before entry.

### 13. Confirmation / Modal Requirements

Dialogs remain inside this screen.

Dialog/sheet là action bên trong màn, không phát sinh screen ID; giữ focus và trả về đúng trigger khi hủy.

### 14. Empty / No-Data State

Published final contest rank: Do not use empty to disguise unpublished/forbidden ranking; explain publication state. Filtered empty states offer clearing available filters; failed reads remain errors. Do not fabricate rows or substitute missing values with0. Unpublished results: “Kết quả chưa được công bố”, distinct from a published empty ranking. Published zero-participant ranking uses a no-results message. No own participation/result: omit own-score/rank section or explain no owned result; never use rank0. USER authentication remains required.

### 15. Loading / Partial Data

Initial load: preserve screen title/navigation, show skeleton only in the loading areas. Independent areas (Publication status, Own result, Final leaderboard, Prize information) may show real loaded data while another area shows retry/unavailable. Disable only the submitting action. Keep valid draft/input and announced request state; do not show success,0, fabricated content or stale entitlement as a confirmed result.

### 16. Mockup Must Show

- Contest name
- Publication/access explanation
- Owned result distinction
- Actual rank/score/duration
- Unavailable versus unpublished

### 17. Mockup Must NOT Show

- Unapproved GUEST full results
- Foreign answers
- Private identity
- Cash claim button
- False zero ranking
- Automatic prize payment
- GUEST entry into SCR-051 inferred from a public contest-detail link

### 18. UX Recommendations

Không áp dụng.

### 19. Responsive Behavior

Desktop: Keep primary data and related detail visible together.

Tablet: Stack secondary panels.

Mobile: Single column; usable primary actions.

### 20. Accessibility

Labels, keyboard operation and screen-specific status announcements.

Áp dụng accessibility chung; label không phụ thuộc placeholder, trạng thái không phụ thuộc màu, control có keyboard/focus và vùng thông báo phù hợp.

### 21. Dependencies / Related Screens

Related Screens:

- SCR-048
- SCR-049
- SCR-050

Related Feature: Contests

Related Data: Server-validated contest final ranking; own result payload only when authorized by contract.

### 22. Open Issues

- UC-090 public-info result link conflicts with the approved authenticated USER branch of SCR-051. Current access follows the frozen flow; clarify link/login and publication payload before implementation, without opening guest access.
- Own result/answer-review payload, pagination and exact prize fulfillment display are not fully defined.

### 23. Mockup Readiness

READY WITH PLACEHOLDERS

Reason: Authenticated USER flow is fixed; result publication and own/leaderboard payload details remain open.

### 9. Validation Rules

Field / Action: hsk_level

Condition: Unsupported HSK level

Message: Chọn cấp HSK hợp lệ.

UI Response: 422 INVALID_HSK_LEVEL; preserve last valid list.

Data State: No mutation.

Condition: Read error 500

User-facing behavior: Show loading failure, not Đang cập nhật.

Retry: Reload list.

Navigation: Remain SCR-053

Data preserved: Type and HSK filter.

Condition: External destination unavailable

User-facing behavior: Keep metadata visible and explain external destination cannot be opened if detected.

Retry: Open approved URL again.

Navigation: Remain SCR-053

Data preserved: List context.

| USER | Published reference metadata | No | No | No | No | No progress/quota/history for link-out. |

No pending eligible work: “Hiện chưa có bài đủ điều kiện để nhận chấm”. No own ASSIGNED: “Bạn chưa có bài đang chấm”. Filtered no-result offers clearing filter; never show another teacher assignment or learner essay to fill space.

Load Pending queue, My assigned work, Policy metadata with protected-data checks before rendering. Keep title, parent link and valid filters; show per-area skeleton/retry, not fake rows or0. During a mutation disable its action, preserve safe input, refresh authoritative status before enabling another decision. Partial successful sections stay readable only within the same actor scope.

### 8. Screen States

| State | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Default | Open with explicit authorised role |
| Loading | Load indicator; relevant pending controls disabled |
| Loaded | Show authoritative fields permitted to actor |
| Empty | Vietnamese empty state without fabricated rows |
| Business Error | Source error, committed data unchanged |
| Unavailable | Load failure with retry; do not substitute empty/zero |
| Editing | Editable source-supported controls show the current draft/filter values; confirmed business data remains unchanged until an accepted write. |
| Validation Error | Associated field errors explain the rules listed in section9; preserve safe input, focus the first actionable error and do not commit invalid data. |
| Read-only | Source records/history/results are read-only outside explicitly listed editable controls and lifecycle conditions; changing a filter does not change a business record. |
| Partial Data | Independent permitted areas may finish separately; show real loaded data plus per-area unavailable/retry. Never expose protected data or enable a dependent action before all its required checks succeed. |
| Disabled | Only controls whose documented Enabled When condition is false, whose request is pending or whose required business contract is unapproved are disabled; explain the actual reason. |

Các trạng thái không liệt kê không áp dụng cho luồng hiện được đặc tả; không tạo UI hoặc trạng thái business mới chỉ để đủ danh sách.

### 9. Validation Rules

Không có validation nhập business riêng; kiểm điều kiện action/role như mục 7 và 11.

### 10. Error Handling

Condition: QUESTION_NOT_PENDING (409)

User-facing behavior: Show existing state; remove handled item, no overwrite

Retry: Reload

Navigation: SCR-058

Data preserved: Other eligible items and outcomes

Condition: MALFORMED_QUESTION (422)

User-facing behavior: No approve; edit/reject

Retry: Correct content

Navigation: SCR-059

Data preserved: PENDING_REVIEW

Condition: Mixed bulk outcomes

User-facing behavior: Report successful/conflicted items separately

Retry: Only still-pending after reload

Navigation: SCR-058

Data preserved: Valid committed decisions

Áp dụng các quy tắc lỗi dùng chung phía trên khi request tương ứng có thể phát sinh; không đổi lỗi credentials thành refresh loop, không lộ private-resource existence hoặc stack trace.

### 11. Role / Permission Behavior

| Actor | Can View | Can Edit | Can Create | Can Archive/Delete | Can Approve/Reject | Special Restrictions |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| TEACHER | AI/PENDING_REVIEW summaries | Selection of items already opened by this reviewer | None | None | Approve individually checked selected pending AI items | Both explicit reviewer roles; selection cannot bypass opening/review; no general question-bank administration inherited Explicit roles only; server revalidates each request. |
| CONTENT_ADMIN | AI/PENDING_REVIEW summaries | Selection of items already opened by this reviewer | None | None | Approve individually checked selected pending AI items | Both explicit reviewer roles; selection cannot bypass opening/review; no general question-bank administration inherited Explicit roles only; server revalidates each request. |

Role còn lại không có quyền thao tác được cấp riêng tại màn này; quyền public read không kéo theo quyền tạo/sửa. Không có role inheritance. SYSTEM không có menu hoặc phiên người dùng. Server kiểm lại role và ownership cho từng request.

### 12. Business Data & Status Values

AI/PENDING_REVIEW queue; APPROVED/REJECTED leave. No new intermediate state.

Preserve business, ownership, audit and transaction rules. Legacy approved/rejected status filter is no longer a way to bypass the pending-only queue. CONTENT_ADMIN bank status browsing belongs to SCR-064; TEACHER does not inherit that bank scope.

### 13. Confirmation / Modal Requirements

Inline confirmation/reason dialogs only; no extra screen IDs.

Dialog/sheet là action bên trong màn, không phát sinh screen ID; giữ focus và trả về đúng trigger khi hủy.

### 14. Empty / No-Data State

“Không có câu hỏi AI đang chờ duyệt”. No selected viewed items keeps bulk approval disabled; no blind select-all or fake sample question.

### 15. Loading / Partial Data

Load Review queue, Bulk review with protected-data checks before rendering. Keep title, parent link and valid filters; show per-area skeleton/retry, not fake rows or0. During a mutation disable its action, preserve safe input, refresh authoritative status before enabling another decision. Partial successful sections stay readable only within the same actor scope.

### 16. Mockup Must Show

- Both roles
- Oldest waiting order
- Viewed-before-bulk rule
- Per-item outcome

### 17. Mockup Must NOT Show

- TEACHER-only gate
- SUPER_ADMIN implicit reviewer
- Blind approve-all
- Unreviewed learner-serving

### 18. UX Recommendations

- UX Recommendation: retain list page/filters when returning from detail.

### 19. Responsive Behavior

Desktop: Readable workspace with all required fields/actions

Tablet: Reflow sections without omitting required information

Mobile: Stack labelled forms; accessible cards/table scrolling retain all required fields Mobile here means mobile web; native admin navigation remains outside MVP per design.md §3.

### 20. Accessibility

Apply the shared accessibility requirements; labelled controls, keyboard/focus, associated field errors, text statuses and live result announcements.

Áp dụng accessibility chung; label không phụ thuộc placeholder, trạng thái không phụ thuộc màu, control có keyboard/focus và vùng thông báo phù hợp.

### 21. Dependencies / Related Screens

Related Screens:

- SCR-059
- SCR-064

Related Feature: Content Management

Related Data: questions.options JSONB; question_knowledge_points; audit_logs. UC API names unconfirmed.

| Disabled | Only controls whose documented Enabled When condition is false, whose request is pending or whose required business contract is unapproved are disabled; explain the actual reason. |
| Success | After server confirmation announce the accepted source-defined outcome, reload authoritative state and prevent repeating the same decision; no optimistic claim of financial or grading success. |

Các trạng thái không liệt kê không áp dụng cho luồng hiện được đặc tả; không tạo UI hoặc trạng thái business mới chỉ để đủ danh sách.

### 9. Validation Rules

Field / Action: knowledge Point Ids

Condition: Empty

Message: Chọn ít nhất một điểm kiến thức.

UI Response: KNOWLEDGE_POINT_REQUIRED (422)

Data State: No save

UI Response: MALFORMED_QUESTION (422)

Data State: Keep old content

Field / Action: rejection Reason

Condition: Empty

Message: Vui lòng nhập lý do từ chối.

UI Response: EMPTY_REJECTION_REASON (422)

Data State: Still pending

### 10. Error Handling

Condition: GRADING_CHANGE_NOT_ALLOWED (409)

User-facing behavior: Require new question and archive old rather than change history

Retry: Limit to permitted edit/approved creation workflow

Navigation: SCR-064 context, no new screen

Data preserved: Question/history

Condition: EDIT_DURING_ACTIVE_CONTEST (409)

User-facing behavior: Read-only lock

Retry: After contest and reload

Navigation: Stay or parent

Data preserved: Existing content

Condition: QUESTION_NOT_PENDING (409)

User-facing behavior: Reload decision, no overwrite

Retry: Reload

Navigation: SCR-058

Data preserved: Committed decision

Áp dụng các quy tắc lỗi dùng chung phía trên khi request tương ứng có thể phát sinh; không đổi lỗi credentials thành refresh loop, không lộ private-resource existence hoặc stack trace.

### 11. Role / Permission Behavior

| Actor | Can View | Can Edit | Can Create | Can Archive/Delete | Can Approve/Reject | Special Restrictions |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| TEACHER | AI pending-review question in authorised review context | Allowed pending AI question/labels only; used semantics and active contest locks apply | No bank authoring right inherited | No question-bank archive/delete right inherited | Approve/reject AI pending-review item only | No inherited SUPER_ADMIN/generic ADMIN privileges; server checks role and scope |
| CONTENT_ADMIN | Authorised AI review and question-bank context | Source-authorised fields; historical grading and active contest locks apply | Only explicitly listed creation action | Archive only when authorised; no hard delete of used question | Only explicitly named review/publication actions | No inherited SUPER_ADMIN/generic ADMIN privileges; server checks role and scope |

Role còn lại không có quyền thao tác được cấp riêng tại màn này; quyền public read không kéo theo quyền tạo/sửa. Không có role inheritance. SYSTEM không có menu hoặc phiên người dùng. Server kiểm lại role và ownership cho từng request.

### 12. Business Data & Status Values

Save is not approve. AI pending may approve/reject; archive preserves history.

Preserve business, ownership, audit and transaction rules.

### 13. Confirmation / Modal Requirements

Rejection requires its nonempty reason control; save remains separate from approve/reject. UX Recommendation: confirm approval/rejection or CONTENT_ADMIN archive with current question/state and consequences. Cancel retains unsaved edit without a decision. Active-contest/history locks cannot be overridden by a dialog.

Dialog/sheet là action bên trong màn, không phát sinh screen ID; giữ focus và trả về đúng trigger khi hủy.

### 14. Empty / No-Data State

No selected permitted question: return to the originating queue/bank. AI pending items may have incomplete explanation/labels; show actual missing controls and approval errors. Missing/archived context does not silently open a create form.

### 15. Loading / Partial Data

Load Question metadata, Content and answers, Knowledge labels, Review decision with protected-data checks before rendering. Keep title, parent link and valid filters; show per-area skeleton/retry, not fake rows or0. During a mutation disable its action, preserve safe input, refresh authoritative status before enabling another decision. Partial successful sections stay readable only within the same actor scope.

### 16. Mockup Must Show

- History-use and active-contest lock
- Shared reviewer role
- Separate save/decision
- Reject reason

### 17. Mockup Must NOT Show

- Duplicate role screens
- Change used grading semantics
- Auto-approve on save
- Hard-delete used question
- TEACHER implicit exam/import rights
- TEACHER archive or general bank administration without explicit CONTENT_ADMIN

Tablet: Reflow sections without omitting required information

Mobile: Stack labelled forms; accessible cards/table scrolling retain all required fields Mobile here means mobile web; native admin navigation remains outside MVP per design.md §3.

### 8. Screen States

| State | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Default | Open with explicit authorised role |
| Loading | Load indicator; relevant pending controls disabled |
| Loaded | Show authoritative fields permitted to actor |
| Empty | Vietnamese empty state without fabricated rows |
| Business Error | Source error, committed data unchanged |
| Unavailable | Load failure with retry; do not substitute empty/zero |
| Editing | Editable source-supported controls show the current draft/filter values; confirmed business data remains unchanged until an accepted write. |
| Validation Error | Associated field errors explain the rules listed in section9; preserve safe input, focus the first actionable error and do not commit invalid data. |
| Read-only | Source records/history/results are read-only outside explicitly listed editable controls and lifecycle conditions; changing a filter does not change a business record. |
| Partial Data | Independent permitted areas may finish separately; show real loaded data plus per-area unavailable/retry. Never expose protected data or enable a dependent action before all its required checks succeed. |
| Disabled | Only controls whose documented Enabled When condition is false, whose request is pending or whose required business contract is unapproved are disabled; explain the actual reason. |
| Success | After server confirmation announce the accepted source-defined outcome, reload authoritative state and prevent repeating the same decision; no optimistic claim of financial or grading success. |

Các trạng thái không liệt kê không áp dụng cho luồng hiện được đặc tả; không tạo UI hoặc trạng thái business mới chỉ để đủ danh sách.

### 9. Validation Rules

Field / Action: sections/questions

Condition: Empty exam/section

Message: Đề và mỗi phần phải có ít nhất một câu hỏi.

UI Response: PUBLISH_EMPTY_EXAM (422)

Data State: Keep DRAFT

Field / Action: audio

Condition: Required listening audio missing

Message: Bổ sung audio bắt buộc trước khi công bố.

UI Response: PUBLISH_WITHOUT_AUDIO (422)

Data State: Keep DRAFT

Field / Action: questions

Condition: Unapproved/unlabelled question

Message: Chọn câu hỏi đã duyệt và có điểm kiến thức.

UI Response: PUBLISH_UNAPPROVED_QUESTION / PUBLISH_UNLABELED_QUESTION (422)

Data State: Keep DRAFT

Field / Action: section Order

Condition: Missing

Message: Xác định thứ tự các phần.

UI Response: SECTION_ORDER_MISSING (422)

Data State: No publication

### 10. Error Handling

Condition: Publication validation fails

User-facing behavior: List exact section/question error; no partial publish

Retry: Fix source-invalid fields then revalidate

Navigation: Remain SCR-066

Data preserved: Draft composition

Condition: Save/audit failure

User-facing behavior: Keep committed old state; retain form

Retry: Reload current state then retry

Navigation: Remain form

Data preserved: No inconsistent published state

Áp dụng các quy tắc lỗi dùng chung phía trên khi request tương ứng có thể phát sinh; không đổi lỗi credentials thành refresh loop, không lộ private-resource existence hoặc stack trace.

### 11. Role / Permission Behavior

| Actor | Can View | Can Edit | Can Create | Can Archive/Delete | Can Approve/Reject | Special Restrictions |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| CONTENT_ADMIN | Authorised exam, sections and selected question metadata | Source-authorised draft/composition fields | DRAFT exam | Archive only; no hard deletion of used exam | Publish only after full source-defined checks | At least one section/question per section, APPROVED labels/media; protect existing attempt history Explicit roles only; server revalidates each request. |

Role còn lại không có quyền thao tác được cấp riêng tại màn này; quyền public read không kéo theo quyền tạo/sửa. Không có role inheritance. SYSTEM không có menu hoặc phiên người dùng. Server kiểm lại role và ownership cho từng request.

### 12. Business Data & Status Values

DRAFT save; explicit valid publication ->PUBLISHED; archive ->ARCHIVED. Preserve attempts; draft copy not published.

Preserve business, ownership, audit and transaction rules.

### 13. Confirmation / Modal Requirements

Inline confirmation/reason dialogs only; no extra screen IDs.

Dialog/sheet là action bên trong màn, không phát sinh screen ID; giữ focus và trả về đúng trigger khi hủy.

### 14. Empty / No-Data State

New DRAFT has no selected questions: offer question-bank selection, display section/question publication checks. Empty sections/questions prevent publication. Edit-load failure does not become a new draft.

### 15. Loading / Partial Data

Load Exam metadata, Sections, Questions, Publication validation with protected-data checks before rendering. Keep title, parent link and valid filters; show per-area skeleton/retry, not fake rows or0. During a mutation disable its action, preserve safe input, refresh authoritative status before enabling another decision. Partial successful sections stay readable only within the same actor scope.

- Ordered sections/questions
- Publication blocking errors
- Audio/review/knowledge-label checks
- Draft versus publish distinction

### 17. Mockup Must NOT Show

- Publish empty/unapproved/unlabelled/listening-noaudio
- Overwrite historical question grading
- Hard-delete exam/history
- Use real-HSK simulation as new requirement

### 18. UX Recommendations

- UX Recommendation: retain list page/filters when returning from detail.

### 19. Responsive Behavior

Desktop: Readable workspace with all required fields/actions

Tablet: Reflow sections without omitting required information

Mobile: Stack labelled forms; accessible cards/table scrolling retain all required fields Mobile here means mobile web; native admin navigation remains outside MVP per design.md §3.

### 20. Accessibility

Apply the shared accessibility requirements; labelled controls, keyboard/focus, associated field errors, text statuses and live result announcements.

Áp dụng accessibility chung; label không phụ thuộc placeholder, trạng thái không phụ thuộc màu, control có keyboard/focus và vùng thông báo phù hợp.

| State | Behavior |

### 9. Validation Rules

Field / Action: file

Condition: Unsupported template/format

Message: File không đúng định dạng đã duyệt.

UI Response: UNSUPPORTED_FILE_FORMAT (422)

Data State: No content rows

Field / Action: file

Condition: Invalid Chinese encoding

Message: Kiểm tra mã hóa chữ Hán của file.

UI Response: ENCODING_ERROR (422)

Data State: No corrupted rows

Field / Action: file

Condition: Exceeds approved max

Message: File vượt kích thước cho phép.

UI Response: FILE_TOO_LARGE (413)

Data State: No file processed

Field / Action: row

Condition: Required label missing or malformed MC

Message: Sửa dòng lỗi; câu hỏi cần điểm kiến thức và đúng một đáp án.

UI Response: Recorded row error

Data State: Invalid row not written; valid rows may succeed

### 10. Error Handling

Condition: CONCURRENT_IMPORT (409)

User-facing behavior: Explain conflicting run; do not duplicate processing

Retry: Reload status before retry

Navigation: SCR-069 for known run

Data preserved: Existing run/content

Condition: Same file hash

User-facing behavior: Inform prior processing; confirmation only approved rerun policy

Retry: Correct file or permitted rerun

Navigation: History/report

Data preserved: No duplicates

Condition: System error while row processing

User-facing behavior: Record accurate outcomes; no half-written content row

Retry: After report and safe-key policy

Navigation: SCR-069

Data preserved: Previously committed valid rows and persistent errors

Áp dụng các quy tắc lỗi dùng chung phía trên khi request tương ứng có thể phát sinh; không đổi lỗi credentials thành refresh loop, không lộ private-resource existence hoặc stack trace.

### 11. Role / Permission Behavior

| Actor | Can View | Can Edit | Can Create | Can Archive/Delete | Can Approve/Reject | Special Restrictions |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| CONTENT_ADMIN | Own authorised import file/validation preview/run summaries | Approved type/file and explicit import confirmation | Validated run/import only after approved staged contract | No destructive replace action without source approval | Confirm validated import, not content-review approval | Approved teacher template/parser/natural keys required; no write during preview; invalid rows remain explainable Explicit roles only; server revalidates each request. |

Role còn lại không có quyền thao tác được cấp riêng tại màn này; quyền public read không kéo theo quyền tạo/sửa. Không có role inheritance. SYSTEM không có menu hoặc phiên người dùng. Server kiểm lại role và ownership cho từng request.

### 12. Business Data & Status Values

Use current service_requests IMPORT lifecycle PENDING/RUNNING/COMPLETED/FAILED where contract confirms; partial success is counts, not invented PARTIAL status.

Preserve business, ownership, audit and transaction rules.

### 13. Confirmation / Modal Requirements

The validated preview and explicit final import confirmation are required stages in SCR-068. Show real valid/error totals and approved natural-key/rerun policy before confirmation. Cancel before confirmation performs no main-content write; report navigation uses SCR-069, never a modal replacing that screen.

Dialog/sheet là action bên trong màn, không phát sinh screen ID; giữ focus và trả về đúng trigger khi hủy.

### 14. Empty / No-Data State

No file: show approved-template guidance; if schema is unapproved explain unavailable import. No historical runs: “Chưa có lần nhập dữ liệu”. All-invalid preview shows actual row errors and no enabled confirmation. No preview rows are invented.

### 15. Loading / Partial Data

Load Approved file upload, Preview, Confirm import, Import history with protected-data checks before rendering. Keep title, parent link and valid filters; show per-area skeleton/retry, not fake rows or0. During a mutation disable its action, preserve safe input, refresh authoritative status before enabling another decision. Partial successful sections stay readable only within the same actor scope.

### 16. Mockup Must Show

- Validate/preview/confirm separation
- Real valid/error totals
- History and report link
- Explicit parser/template readiness
- Teacher copyright warning

### 17. Mockup Must NOT Show

- Import without preview/confirm
- Invented CSV/XLSX columns/natural keys/size/extensions
- Destructive replace mode inferred from legacy
- Entire-file rollback for one row error
- Teacher content committed to git
- Duplicate rerun records

### 18. UX Recommendations

- UX Recommendation: retain list page/filters when returning from detail.

### 19. Responsive Behavior

Desktop: Readable workspace with all required fields/actions

Tablet: Reflow sections without omitting required information

Mobile: Stack labelled forms; accessible cards/table scrolling retain all required fields Mobile here means mobile web; native admin navigation remains outside MVP per design.md §3.

### 20. Accessibility

Apply the shared accessibility requirements; labelled controls, keyboard/focus, associated field errors, text statuses and live result announcements.

Áp dụng accessibility chung; label không phụ thuộc placeholder, trạng thái không phụ thuộc màu, control có keyboard/focus và vùng thông báo phù hợp.

| Success | After server confirmation announce the accepted source-defined outcome, reload authoritative state and prevent repeating the same decision; no optimistic claim of financial or grading success. |

Các trạng thái không liệt kê không áp dụng cho luồng hiện được đặc tả; không tạo UI hoặc trạng thái business mới chỉ để đủ danh sách.

### 9. Validation Rules

Không có validation nhập business riêng; kiểm điều kiện action/role như mục 7 và 11.

### 10. Error Handling

Condition: RANKING_PUBLISHED_EARLY (409)

User-facing behavior: Block before end

Retry: After end

Navigation: Remain list

Data preserved: Results private

Condition: EDIT_DURING_CONTEST (409)

User-facing behavior: Lock schedule/exam/prize edits

Retry: Only permitted future context

Navigation: SCR-071 read-only

Data preserved: Committed contest

Áp dụng các quy tắc lỗi dùng chung phía trên khi request tương ứng có thể phát sinh; không đổi lỗi credentials thành refresh loop, không lộ private-resource existence hoặc stack trace.

### 11. Role / Permission Behavior

| Actor | Can View | Can Edit | Can Create | Can Archive/Delete | Can Approve/Reject | Special Restrictions |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| CONTENT_ADMIN | Managed contest lifecycle/schedule/result-publication context | None directly; editor SCR-071 | DRAFT contest through SCR-071 | Cancel only as permitted, preserving history | Publish ranking after contest ends and server validation | CONTENT_ADMIN does not award financial credits; active schedule/exam/prizes cannot be changed Explicit roles only; server revalidates each request. |

Role còn lại không có quyền thao tác được cấp riêng tại màn này; quyền public read không kéo theo quyền tạo/sửa. Không có role inheritance. SYSTEM không có menu hoặc phiên người dùng. Server kiểm lại role và ownership cho từng request.

### 12. Business Data & Status Values

DRAFT/PUBLISHED/CLOSED/CANCELLED; upcoming/live/ended may be derived time display, not invented DB states.

Preserve business, ownership, audit and transaction rules.

### 13. Confirmation / Modal Requirements

Inline confirmation/reason dialogs only; no extra screen IDs.

Dialog/sheet là action bên trong màn, không phát sinh screen ID; giữ focus và trả về đúng trigger khi hủy.

### 14. Empty / No-Data State

“Chưa có cuộc thi”; offer create DRAFT when V2 enabled. No published ranking timestamp means not yet published, not a fabricated timestamp.

### 15. Loading / Partial Data

Load Managed contests with protected-data checks before rendering. Keep title, parent link and valid filters; show per-area skeleton/retry, not fake rows or0. During a mutation disable its action, preserve safe input, refresh authoritative status before enabling another decision. Partial successful sections stay readable only within the same actor scope.

### 8. Screen States

| State | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Default | Open with explicit authorised role |
| Loading | Load indicator; relevant pending controls disabled |
| Loaded | Show authoritative fields permitted to actor |
| Empty | Vietnamese empty state without fabricated rows |
| Business Error | Source error, committed data unchanged |
| Unavailable | Load failure with retry; do not substitute empty/zero |
| Editing | Editable source-supported controls show the current draft/filter values; confirmed business data remains unchanged until an accepted write. |
| Validation Error | Associated field errors explain the rules listed in section9; preserve safe input, focus the first actionable error and do not commit invalid data. |
| Read-only | Source records/history/results are read-only outside explicitly listed editable controls and lifecycle conditions; changing a filter does not change a business record. |
| Partial Data | Independent permitted areas may finish separately; show real loaded data plus per-area unavailable/retry. Never expose protected data or enable a dependent action before all its required checks succeed. |
| Disabled | Only controls whose documented Enabled When condition is false, whose request is pending or whose required business contract is unapproved are disabled; explain the actual reason. |
| Success | After server confirmation announce the accepted source-defined outcome, reload authoritative state and prevent repeating the same decision; no optimistic claim of financial or grading success. |

Các trạng thái không liệt kê không áp dụng cho luồng hiện được đặc tả; không tạo UI hoặc trạng thái business mới chỉ để đủ danh sách.

| State | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Default | Open with explicit authorised role |
| Loading | Load indicator; relevant pending controls disabled |
| Loaded | Show authoritative fields permitted to actor |

| Business Error | Source error, committed data unchanged |
| Unavailable | Load failure with retry; do not substitute empty/zero |
| Editing | Editable source-supported controls show the current draft/filter values; confirmed business data remains unchanged until an accepted write. |
| Validation Error | Associated field errors explain the rules listed in section9; preserve safe input, focus the first actionable error and do not commit invalid data. |
| Read-only | Source records/history/results are read-only outside explicitly listed editable controls and lifecycle conditions; changing a filter does not change a business record. |
| Partial Data | Independent permitted areas may finish separately; show real loaded data plus per-area unavailable/retry. Never expose protected data or enable a dependent action before all its required checks succeed. |
| Disabled | Only controls whose documented Enabled When condition is false, whose request is pending or whose required business contract is unapproved are disabled; explain the actual reason. |
| Success | After server confirmation announce the accepted source-defined outcome, reload authoritative state and prevent repeating the same decision; no optimistic claim of financial or grading success. |

### 9. Validation Rules
