### 10. Error Handling

Áp dụng các quy tắc lỗi dùng chung phía trên khi request tương ứng có thể phát sinh; không đổi lỗi credentials thành refresh loop, không lộ private-resource existence hoặc stack trace.

### 11. Role / Permission Behavior

| Actor | Can View | Can Edit | Can Create | Can Archive/Delete | Can Approve/Reject | Special Restrictions |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| CONTENT_ADMIN | YouTube/podcast/book metadata and visibility | Source-approved metadata and HTTPS external links | Unpublished resource record | Hide only; retain record/audit | Publish valid source-approved metadata | Approved allowlists/catalogue/storage still pending; never upload copyrighted book or audio/video content Explicit roles only; server revalidates each request. |

Role còn lại không có quyền thao tác được cấp riêng tại màn này; quyền public read không kéo theo quyền tạo/sửa. Không có role inheritance. SYSTEM không có menu hoặc phiên người dùng. Server kiểm lại role và ownership cho từng request.

### 12. Business Data & Status Values

Initial unpublished; publish/hide logical states only until physical storage mapping approved.

Preserve business, ownership, audit and transaction rules.

### 13. Confirmation / Modal Requirements

Inline confirmation/reason dialogs only; no extra screen IDs.

Dialog/sheet là action bên trong màn, không phát sinh screen ID; giữ focus và trả về đúng trigger khi hủy.

### 14. Empty / No-Data State

“Chưa có tài nguyên”; offer create unpublished metadata when catalogue/allowlist contract is ready. No URL for an optional book link keeps the action absent; unapproved allowlist is a blocked control, not empty publication.

### 15. Loading / Partial Data

Load Resource list, Add/edit form, Publication with protected-data checks before rendering. Keep title, parent link and valid filters; show per-area skeleton/retry, not fake rows or0. During a mutation disable its action, preserve safe input, refresh authoritative status before enabling another decision. Partial successful sections stay readable only within the same actor scope.

### 16. Mockup Must Show

- Three resource types
- Unpublished default
- HTTPS/allowlist validation
- Book links optional and metadata only

### 17. Mockup Must NOT Show

- Download/embed/rehost third-party content
- Copyright PDF/book content
- Save a cover without confirmed rights
- Invented whitelisted domains
- Arbitrary resource types
- Hard-delete hidden item

### 18. UX Recommendations

- UX Recommendation: retain list page/filters when returning from detail.

### 19. Responsive Behavior

Desktop: Readable workspace with all required fields/actions

Tablet: Reflow sections without omitting required information

Mobile: Stack labelled forms; accessible cards/table scrolling retain all required fields Mobile here means mobile web; native admin navigation remains outside MVP per design.md §3.

### 20. Accessibility

Apply the shared accessibility requirements; labelled controls, keyboard/focus, associated field errors, text statuses and live result announcements.

Áp dụng accessibility chung; label không phụ thuộc placeholder, trạng thái không phụ thuộc màu, control có keyboard/focus và vùng thông báo phù hợp.

READY WITH PLACEHOLDERS

Role còn lại không có quyền thao tác được cấp riêng tại màn này; quyền public read không kéo theo quyền tạo/sửa. Không có role inheritance. SYSTEM không có menu hoặc phiên người dùng. Server kiểm lại role và ownership cho từng request.

### 12. Business Data & Status Values

UNUSED -> USED or VOIDED. Issuance/void never deletes rows; no EXPIRED state invented for timestamp expiry.

Preserve business, ownership, audit and transaction rules.

### 13. Confirmation / Modal Requirements

Required one-time creation output shows raw issued codes/download only after committed issuance and warns that they cannot be retrieved later. No raw codes in later batch detail. UX Recommendation: closing unsaved output warns of one-time loss; void confirmation identifies only UNUSED subset and leaves USED unchanged. Never persist raw output to logs or storage for recovery. Issuance confirmation is required by the preserved legacy control; display actual validated inputs, not invented denominations.

Dialog/sheet là action bên trong màn, không phát sinh screen ID; giữ focus và trả về đúng trigger khi hủy.

### 14. Empty / No-Data State

“Chưa có lô mã”; offer allowed issuance. No codes to void explains that no UNUSED codes remain. One-time creation output absent/closed cannot be recovered by an empty-state download action. Zero usage ratio only when numerator/denominator are known and meaningful.

### 15. Loading / Partial Data

Load Batch list, Issue batch, One-time output, Funnel summary with protected-data checks before rendering. Keep title, parent link and valid filters; show per-area skeleton/retry, not fake rows or0. During a mutation disable its action, preserve safe input, refresh authoritative status before enabling another decision. Partial successful sections stay readable only within the same actor scope.

### 16. Mockup Must Show

- Maximum 100 validation
- Conditional partner/gift fields
- One-time raw-code warning/download
- Status-only later views
- Funnel used/total

### 17. Mockup Must NOT Show

- Maximum 1000 override of accepted 100
- Raw-code re-download/history
- Code/hash in logs or list
- Void USED codes
- Cash checkout/webhooks
- Arbitrary partner table
- issued_to redemption ownership restriction

### 18. UX Recommendations

- UX Recommendation: retain list page/filters when returning from detail.

### 19. Responsive Behavior

Desktop: Readable workspace with all required fields/actions

Tablet: Reflow sections without omitting required information

Mobile: Stack labelled forms; accessible cards/table scrolling retain all required fields Mobile here means mobile web; native admin navigation remains outside MVP per design.md §3.

### 20. Accessibility

Apply the shared accessibility requirements; labelled controls, keyboard/focus, associated field errors, text statuses and live result announcements.

Áp dụng accessibility chung; label không phụ thuộc placeholder, trạng thái không phụ thuộc màu, control có keyboard/focus và vùng thông báo phù hợp.

### 8. Screen States

| State | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Default | Open with explicit authorised role |
| Loading | Load indicator; relevant pending controls disabled |
| Loaded | Show authoritative fields permitted to actor |
| Empty | Vietnamese empty state without fabricated rows |
| Business Error | Source error, committed data unchanged |
| Unavailable | Load failure with retry; do not substitute empty/zero |
| Editing | Editable source-supported controls show the current draft/filter values; confirmed business data remains unchanged until an accepted write. |
| Validation Error | Associated field errors explain the rules listed in section9; preserve safe input, focus the first actionable error and do not commit invalid data. |
| Read-only | Source records/history/results are read-only outside explicitly listed editable controls and lifecycle conditions; changing a filter does not change a business record. |
| Partial Data | Independent permitted areas may finish separately; show real loaded data plus per-area unavailable/retry. Never expose protected data or enable a dependent action before all its required checks succeed. |
| Disabled | Only controls whose documented Enabled When condition is false, whose request is pending or whose required business contract is unapproved are disabled; explain the actual reason. |
| Success | After server confirmation announce the accepted source-defined outcome, reload authoritative state and prevent repeating the same decision; no optimistic claim of financial or grading success. |

Các trạng thái không liệt kê không áp dụng cho luồng hiện được đặc tả; không tạo UI hoặc trạng thái business mới chỉ để đủ danh sách.

### 9. Validation Rules

Field / Action: price/duration/benefits

Condition: Invalid approved configuration

Message: Kiểm tra giá, thời hạn và quyền lợi của gói.

UI Response: INVALID_PLAN_DATA (422)

Data State: Old definition preserved

Field / Action: code/name

Condition: Duplicate

Message: Gói đã tồn tại.

UI Response: DUPLICATE_PLAN (409)

Data State: No duplicate

### 10. Error Handling

Condition: GRANTED_BENEFIT_CANNOT_BE_PRESERVED (409)

User-facing behavior: Block change, not just warn and save

Retry: Only after approved preservation design or harmless edit

Navigation: Remain SCR-074

Data preserved: Granted user/card rights

Condition: PLAN_WRITE_ERROR (500)/auditfailure

User-facing behavior: Rollback catalog change

Retry: Reload then permitted retry

Navigation: Stay

Data preserved: Old definition/history

Áp dụng các quy tắc lỗi dùng chung phía trên khi request tương ứng có thể phát sinh; không đổi lỗi credentials thành refresh loop, không lộ private-resource existence hoặc stack trace.

### 6. Lists / Tables / Cards

Optional columns/items: seq only after approved implementation

Search: Source-supported user search only

Filters: Required date range; optional user/type

Actions: View supporting data; export bounded CSV; reconcile; append an authorised adjustment

Empty state: Before valid date range: request scope rather than query all history. Valid scope with no transactions: “Không có giao dịch trong khoảng đã chọn”; aggregate0 only if server confirms. No reconciliation anomaly: state no mismatch found for the confirmed scope, not a fabricated reconciliation.

Selection behavior: Open one record; bulk only if explicitly allowed

### 8. Screen States

| State | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Default | Open with explicit authorised role |
| Loading | Load indicator; relevant pending controls disabled |
| Loaded | Show authoritative fields permitted to actor |
| Empty | Vietnamese empty state without fabricated rows |
| Business Error | Source error, committed data unchanged |
| Unavailable | Load failure with retry; do not substitute empty/zero |
| Editing | Editable source-supported controls show the current draft/filter values; confirmed business data remains unchanged until an accepted write. |
| Validation Error | Associated field errors explain the rules listed in section9; preserve safe input, focus the first actionable error and do not commit invalid data. |
| Read-only | Source records/history/results are read-only outside explicitly listed editable controls and lifecycle conditions; changing a filter does not change a business record. |
| Partial Data | Independent permitted areas may finish separately; show real loaded data plus per-area unavailable/retry. Never expose protected data or enable a dependent action before all its required checks succeed. |
| Disabled | Only controls whose documented Enabled When condition is false, whose request is pending or whose required business contract is unapproved are disabled; explain the actual reason. |
| Success | After server confirmation announce the accepted source-defined outcome, reload authoritative state and prevent repeating the same decision; no optimistic claim of financial or grading success. |

Các trạng thái không liệt kê không áp dụng cho luồng hiện được đặc tả; không tạo UI hoặc trạng thái business mới chỉ để đủ danh sách.

### 9. Validation Rules

Field / Action: date Range

Condition: Missing/invalid

Message: Chọn khoảng thời gian hợp lệ.

UI Response: INVALID_DATE_RANGE (422)

Data State: No unbounded query

Field / Action: export

Condition: Unbounded

Message: Giới hạn khoảng thời gian xuất báo cáo.

UI Response: UNBOUNDED_EXPORT (422)

Data State: No export

Field / Action: adjustment

Condition: Missing reason/ref, zero amount or negative resulting balance

Message: Nhập điều chỉnh hợp lệ, có lý do và mã tham chiếu.

UI Response: INVALID_ADJUSTMENT (422)

Data State: No append

### 10. Error Handling

Condition: SELF_ADJUSTMENT (403)

User-facing behavior: Block own accountcorrection

Retry: Another authorised actor under existing policy

Navigation: Remain on the ledger

Data preserved: Balance/history

Condition: DUPLICATE_ADJUSTMENT (409)

User-facing behavior: Show the already handled reference; no second transaction

Retry: Reload the reference

Navigation: Remain in the inline investigation

Data preserved: One existing effect

Condition: LEDGER_READ_ERROR (500)/audit readfailure

User-facing behavior: No protected data without required audit; fail the read clearly

Retry: Reload

Navigation: Stay

Data preserved: Ledger unchanged

Condition: ADJUSTMENT_WRITE_ERROR (500)

User-facing behavior: Roll back the append and audit

Retry: Check authoritative reference/status before retry

Navigation: Stay

Data preserved: Old ledger chain

Condition: Reconciliation mismatch

User-facing behavior: Show evidence requiring investigation; no automatic ledger modification

Retry: Investigate consistent source

Navigation: Inline

Data preserved: All old transactions

Áp dụng các quy tắc lỗi dùng chung phía trên khi request tương ứng có thể phát sinh; không đổi lỗi credentials thành refresh loop, không lộ private-resource existence hoặc stack trace.

### 11. Role / Permission Behavior

| Actor | Can View | Can Edit | Can Create | Can Archive/Delete | Can Approve/Reject | Special Restrictions |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| FINANCE_ADMIN | Masked permitted ledger/source investigation and reconciliation | Filter fields and unsaved adjustment draft only; ledger rows immutable | Authorised compensating ADJUSTMENT or source-based refund workflow | No transaction edit/delete | No invented two-person approval workflow | Not own account; nonzero integer adjustment, nonnegative balance, reason/reference, duplicate prevention and atomic audit Explicit roles only; server revalidates each request. |

Role còn lại không có quyền thao tác được cấp riêng tại màn này; quyền public read không kéo theo quyền tạo/sửa. Không có role inheritance. SYSTEM không có menu hoặc phiên người dùng. Server kiểm lại role và ownership cho từng request.

### 12. Business Data & Status Values

Append-only ledger. No transaction update/delete. Support dispute conclusion has no invented ticket status catalogue. Amount0 SUBSCRIPTION leaves balance unchanged.

Preserve business, ownership, audit and transaction rules.

### 13. Confirmation / Modal Requirements

Adjustment form requires target, signed integer amount, reason and case/reference. Required final confirmation shows authorised target, before/after balance and reason; cancel writes nothing. Ledger rows have no edit/delete dialog. Existing support investigation is inline, with no new dispute screen or invented approval workflow.

Dialog/sheet là action bên trong màn, không phát sinh screen ID; giữ focus và trả về đúng trigger khi hủy.

### 14. Empty / No-Data State

Before valid date range: request scope rather than query all history. Valid scope with no transactions: “Không có giao dịch trong khoảng đã chọn”; aggregate0 only if server confirms. No reconciliation anomaly: state no mismatch found for the confirmed scope, not a fabricated reconciliation.

### 15. Loading / Partial Data

Load Required time filter, Append-only ledger, Reconciliation, Dispute investigation, Authorised adjustment with protected-data checks before rendering. Keep title, parent link and valid filters; show per-area skeleton/retry, not fake rows or0. During a mutation disable its action, preserve safe input, refresh authoritative status before enabling another decision. Partial successful sections stay readable only within the same actor scope.

### 16. Mockup Must Show

- Required dates/paging
- Signed amount and both balances
- Whole filtered totals
- Read/export/reconcile audit
- Inline reason/reference adjustment
- Masked PII

### 17. Mockup Must NOT Show

- Edit/delete ledger rows
- Optional date unbounded query
- Internal dispute ticket queue or page
- Credit totals called cash revenue
- Automatic adjustment after reconciliation
- Self-adjustment
- ADJUSTMENT bypassing verified REFUND
- Cards/rawcode/hash

### 18. UX Recommendations

- UX Recommendation: retain list page/filters when returning from detail.

### 19. Responsive Behavior

Desktop: Readable workspace with all required fields/actions

Tablet: Reflow sections without omitting required information

Mobile: Stack labelled forms; accessible cards/table scrolling retain all required fields Mobile here means mobile web; native admin navigation remains outside MVP per design.md §3.

### 20. Accessibility

Apply the shared accessibility requirements; labelled controls, keyboard/focus, associated field errors, text statuses and live result announcements.

Áp dụng accessibility chung; label không phụ thuộc placeholder, trạng thái không phụ thuộc màu, control có keyboard/focus và vùng thông báo phù hợp.

### 21. Dependencies / Related Screens

Related Screens:

- SCR-073
- SCR-074
- SCR-031

Related Feature: Finance Management

Related Data: Current V1 append-only credit_transactions; no user_credits. seq proposed, stable order by current id; unique REFUND/dispute reference already exists. UC API examples only.

### 22. Open Issues

- SF30 legacy dates optional and complaint queue conflict with UC100required scope/UC102external support; use detailed source/frozen inline flow.
- seq not implemented; existing INTEGER points differ from the BIGINT contract; do not migrate.
- Two-person approval/adjustment thresholds unapproved; do not invent.

READY WITH PLACEHOLDERS

Reason: Ledger/investigation/adjustment layout supported; exact query/export and sequence contracts remain open.

### 8. Screen States

| State | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Default | Open with explicit authorised role |
| Loading | Load indicator; relevant pending controls disabled |
| Loaded | Show authoritative fields permitted to actor |
| Empty | Vietnamese empty state without fabricated rows |
| Business Error | Source error, committed data unchanged |
| Unavailable | Load failure with retry; do not substitute empty/zero |
| Editing | Editable source-supported controls show the current draft/filter values; confirmed business data remains unchanged until an accepted write. |
| Validation Error | Associated field errors explain the rules listed in section9; preserve safe input, focus the first actionable error and do not commit invalid data. |
| Read-only | Source records/history/results are read-only outside explicitly listed editable controls and lifecycle conditions; changing a filter does not change a business record. |
| Partial Data | Independent permitted areas may finish separately; show real loaded data plus per-area unavailable/retry. Never expose protected data or enable a dependent action before all its required checks succeed. |
| Disabled | Only controls whose documented Enabled When condition is false, whose request is pending or whose required business contract is unapproved are disabled; explain the actual reason. |
| Success | After server confirmation announce the accepted source-defined outcome, reload authoritative state and prevent repeating the same decision; no optimistic claim of financial or grading success. |

Các trạng thái không liệt kê không áp dụng cho luồng hiện được đặc tả; không tạo UI hoặc trạng thái business mới chỉ để đủ danh sách.

### 9. Validation Rules

Field / Action: restriction Reason

Condition: Empty

Message: Vui lòng nhập lý do khóa tài khoản.

UI Response: EMPTY_BAN_REASON (422)

Data State: No restriction

Field / Action: role Code

Condition: Not one of six

Message: Chọn vai trò hợp lệ.

UI Response: INVALID_ROLE_CODE (422)

Data State: No role change

### 10. Error Handling

Condition: SELF_BAN (409) / BAN_LAST_SUPER_ADMIN (409)

User-facing behavior: Block restriction

Retry: No bypass

Navigation: Stay SCR-077

Data preserved: Account and administrator availability

Condition: SELF_ROLE_GRANT (403)

User-facing behavior: Cannot grant own additional roles

Retry: Another authorised administrator under existing policy

Navigation: Stay

Data preserved: Explicit roles

Condition: ROLE_GRANTED_TO_BANNED_USER (409)

User-facing behavior: Block new grant to locked/banned target

Retry: Only after allowed restriction removal

Navigation: Stay

Data preserved: Roles

Condition: REVOKE_LAST_SUPER_ADMIN (409)

User-facing behavior: Block last active administrator removal

Retry: No bypass

Navigation: Stay

Data preserved: Last active administrator

Condition: USER_NOT_FOUND (404)

User-facing behavior: Target unavailable

Retry: Reload list

Navigation: SCR-076

Data preserved: No action

Condition: Grant already exists / revoke already absent

User-facing behavior: Show authoritative idempotent state; no duplicate relation

Retry: Not necessary

Navigation: Stay

Data preserved: Current relation state

Áp dụng các quy tắc lỗi dùng chung phía trên khi request tương ứng có thể phát sinh; không đổi lỗi credentials thành refresh loop, không lộ private-resource existence hoặc stack trace.

### 11. Role / Permission Behavior

| Actor | Can View | Can Edit | Can Create | Can Archive/Delete | Can Approve/Reject | Special Restrictions |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| SUPER_ADMIN | Authorised account detail, roles, restrictions; V2 login/audit history only when supplied | Role/restriction action draft fields; not user profile/password/credit balance | Role relation via permitted grant only | Revoke role/remove restriction only; no account/history hard delete | None | No self-grant, preserve last active SUPER_ADMIN; reason/audit/revoke sessions; no inherited finance/content/manager authority Explicit roles only; server revalidates each request. |

Role còn lại không có quyền thao tác được cấp riêng tại màn này; quyền public read không kéo theo quyền tạo/sửa. Không có role inheritance. SYSTEM không có menu hoặc phiên người dùng. Server kiểm lại role và ownership cho từng request.

### 12. Business Data & Status Values

Account restrictions and role membership are separate contracts. Ban revokes old access; unban requires new sign-in. Role changes revoke old sessions.

Preserve business, ownership, audit and transaction rules.

### 13. Confirmation / Modal Requirements

Role grant/revoke and approved restriction dialogs show target, role/reason and source-defined session effects. Required confirmation for the listed grant/revoke/restriction actions. Last-active-SUPER_ADMIN and self-grant protections apply before and during submit; a confirmation cannot override them. No password/secret viewing dialog.

Dialog/sheet là action bên trong màn, không phát sinh screen ID; giữ focus và trả về đúng trigger khi hủy.

### 14. Empty / No-Data State

No V2 successful-login/audit history: explain no supplied history. No selected account: return SCR-076; absent/forbidden account is an error. Empty optional restriction reason means no active restriction only if state confirms it.

### 15. Loading / Partial Data

Load Permitted account detail, Account restriction, Explicit role assignment, Audit history, Successful login history with protected-data checks before rendering. Keep title, parent link and valid filters; show per-area skeleton/retry, not fake rows or0. During a mutation disable its action, preserve safe input, refresh authoritative status before enabling another decision. Partial successful sections stay readable only within the same actor scope.

### 16. Mockup Must Show

- Detail-read audit
- Current explicit roles
- Required restriction reason
- Self/last-administrator safeguards
- V2 login history boundary

### 17. Mockup Must NOT Show

- Role catalogue CRUD
- GUEST/SYSTEM role assignment
- Self-grant
- Ban self/last active SUPER_ADMIN
- Preserve old access after role removal
- Automatic session restoration
- Full login IP
- Inherited content/finance privileges

### 18. UX Recommendations

- UX Recommendation: retain list page/filters when returning from detail.

### 19. Responsive Behavior

Desktop: Readable workspace with all required fields/actions

Tablet: Reflow sections without omitting required information

Mobile: Stack labelled forms; accessible cards/table scrolling retain all required fields Mobile here means mobile web; native admin navigation remains outside MVP per design.md §3.

### 20. Accessibility

Apply the shared accessibility requirements; labelled controls, keyboard/focus, associated field errors, text statuses and live result announcements.

Áp dụng accessibility chung; label không phụ thuộc placeholder, trạng thái không phụ thuộc màu, control có keyboard/focus và vùng thông báo phù hợp.

### 21. Dependencies / Related Screens

Related Screens:

- SCR-076
- SCR-063
- SCR-079

Related Feature: System Administration

Related Data: Current users/user_roles/auth_tokens plus audit_logs; roles table still V1, removal is only proposed. No schema change needed to document UI.

### 22. Open Issues

- UC-114 storage blocker stale; physical fields already exist, but approved lock/suspend/ban action mapping remains incomplete.
- Manual lock/suspend controls in legacy SF32 are broader than detailed UC-114; no duration/policy invented.
- Role grant/revoke race and old access-token invalidation require implementation design; no API currently exists.

READY WITH PLACEHOLDERS

Reason: Account/role safeguards clear; exact restriction action policy and optional V2 history query need confirmation.

### 10. Error Handling

Condition: UNKNOWN_SETTING_KEY (404)

User-facing behavior: No arbitrary key creation

Retry: Choose approved key

Navigation: Stay SCR-078

Data preserved: Old catalogue

Condition: SETTING_CHANGE_NOT_SAFE (409)

User-facing behavior: Block progress-affecting change without approved recalculation, or active-contest impact

Retry: Only approved safe context

Navigation: Stay

Data preserved: Existing values/progress/contest

Condition: Catalogue/storage not approved

User-facing behavior: Keep operational settings blocked; inventory entry remains

Retry: After product/design approval

Navigation: Back to authorised navigation

Data preserved: No schema/key creation

Condition: Write/audit/cache consistency failure

User-facing behavior: Keep old authoritative value; explain failure

Retry: Reload before retry

Navigation: Stay

Data preserved: Old values across system

Áp dụng các quy tắc lỗi dùng chung phía trên khi request tương ứng có thể phát sinh; không đổi lỗi credentials thành refresh loop, không lộ private-resource existence hoặc stack trace.

### 11. Role / Permission Behavior

| Actor | Can View | Can Edit | Can Create | Can Archive/Delete | Can Approve/Reject | Special Restrictions |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| SUPER_ADMIN | Approved non-secret business setting catalogue only when available | Declared type/range value only after approval | No arbitrary setting-key creation | No setting deletion action | None | Deferred; catalogue/storage and safe effect unapproved; no environment, credential, API-key or token displays Explicit roles only; server revalidates each request. |

Role còn lại không có quyền thao tác được cấp riêng tại màn này; quyền public read không kéo theo quyền tạo/sửa. Không có role inheritance. SYSTEM không có menu hoặc phiên người dùng. Server kiểm lại role và ownership cho từng request.

### 12. Business Data & Status Values

Deferred implementation; frozen screen inventory entry remains. No settings catalogue or system_settings table declared by this migration.

Preserve business, ownership, audit and transaction rules.

### 13. Confirmation / Modal Requirements

No fabricated setting catalogue/dialog fields. After approval, value editing/confirmation remains inline and shows key/type/allowed range and approved effect. UX Recommendation: confirm consequential changes with old/new non-secret values. Until then controls are unavailable; no save is claimed.

Dialog/sheet là action bên trong màn, không phát sinh screen ID; giữ focus và trả về đúng trigger khi hủy.

### 14. Empty / No-Data State

Catalogue unapproved: show “Danh mục cấu hình chưa được duyệt” and no fabricated key/value rows. Approved empty catalogue is a separate no-configurable-items state. Source-load failure never displays fake defaults.

### 15. Loading / Partial Data

Load Deferred readiness notice, Approved setting list, Selected setting form, Change audit with protected-data checks before rendering. Keep title, parent link and valid filters; show per-area skeleton/retry, not fake rows or0. During a mutation disable its action, preserve safe input, refresh authoritative status before enabling another decision. Partial successful sections stay readable only within the same actor scope.

### 16. Mockup Must Show

- Deferred state
- Catalogue/storage approval gap
- Only approved keys/types/defaults/ranges
- Read-only key and safe-effect validation

### 17. Mockup Must NOT Show

- Invented setting keys/defaults/ranges
- Arbitrary key creation
- Secrets/API keys/passwords/tokens
- New system_settings schema
- Change active-contest rules
- Change learner progress without approved recalculation
- Claim UI screen is absent from canonical inventory

### 18. UX Recommendations

- UX Recommendation: retain list page/filters when returning from detail.

### 19. Responsive Behavior

Desktop: Readable workspace with all required fields/actions

Tablet: Reflow sections without omitting required information

Mobile: Stack labelled forms; accessible cards/table scrolling retain all required fields Mobile here means mobile web; native admin navigation remains outside MVP per design.md §3.

### 20. Accessibility

Apply the shared accessibility requirements; labelled controls, keyboard/focus, associated field errors, text statuses and live result announcements.

Áp dụng accessibility chung; label không phụ thuộc placeholder, trạng thái không phụ thuộc màu, control có keyboard/focus và vùng thông báo phù hợp.
